paper_title: Search for sub-eV axion-like particles in a quasi-parallel stimulated resonant photon-photon collider with "coronagraphy"
notes: Paper reports exclusion limits on ALP-photon coupling g/M vs mass m for both scalar and pseudoscalar ALPs using stimulated resonant photon-photon collisions (SRPC). The most sensitive point is g/M = 5.45×10^-7 GeV^-1 at m = 0.15 eV for pseudoscalar ALPs (Figure 11). The paper concludes that observed FWM photons are dominated by optical-element-originating atomic FWM (opt-aFWM) background, not vacuum FWM signal from ALP exchanges, based on focal-spot overlap degradation tests. Therefore, the reported limits are upper bounds on the coupling. Data points extracted from Figure 11 (pseudoscalar case) showing the exclusion region boundary.
